about: Chapter 87 opens with Makeda making her lords swear by heavenly Zion that only David’s male seed shall rule Ethiopia. The clergy administer the oath, the people give up idols and vices, and the book sets Ethiopia’s rise beside Israel’s fall as Zion comes to Ethiopia. Makeda gives the kingdom to her son David (Menelik). He pledges obedience and asks her prayer, speaks of the law from his anointing by Zadok, and ends with the trumpet-blasts at Jerusalem and the shaking of earth and heaven.

sentences.i: And she said to her lords: Say then (?): swear by heavenly Zion that you will not set women on the throne of the kingdom of Ethiopia, except the seed of David, son of Solomon, a male king, for ever;
sentences.n: ወትቤሎሙ ‘and she said to them’ (ትቤ 3fs of ይቤ, the speaker is Makeda; ለመኳንንቲሃ ‘to her lords’ repeats the object, the house pattern of suffix plus ለ-). በሉኬ is በሉ (imperative plural of ብህለ ‘say’) + -ኬ ‘then, indeed’; I keep the plain sense ‘say then’ (?), with መሐሉ the imperative ‘swear!’ (a summons such as ‘come now’ is not in the form) (the same spelling as the perfect ‘they swore’ in the heading). በጽዮን ሰማያዊት ‘by heavenly Zion’: Zion is the Ark (ታቦት). ከመ ኢታንግሡ is the negative subjunctive (2mp) of አንገሠ ‘make king’, ‘that you not enthrone’; አንስተ ‘women’ is accusative. መንበረ መንግሥተ ኢትዮጵያ ‘throne-of kingdom-of Ethiopia’ is a double construct. ዘእንበለ ‘except’; ዘርኡ ለዳዊት ‘his seed, of David’ (anticipatory suffix: ‘David’s seed’). ዳዊት is Menelik’s regnal name (see chs. 38–39, 53), son of Solomon. ንጉሥ ተባዕተ ‘king, male’ (ተባዕት ‘male’, accusative). እስከ ለዓለም ‘until for ever’.

sentences.i: Elmeyas and Azariah, chief of the priests and chief of the deacons, made them swear; and the sons of the host of Israel (?) renewed the kingdom and made a law with their king David in the Tent of Testimony; the kingdom was renewed, the hearts of men grew bright at the sight of Zion, the Ark of God’s law, and the people of Ethiopia cast away their idols and worshipped their Creator, the God who made them;
sentences.n: ወአምሐልዎሙ ‘and they made them swear’ (አምሐለ, the causative of መሐለ ‘swear’, 3mp perfect + -ዎሙ ‘them’, as ወአምሐልዎ in ch. 72); the plural verb fits the two subjects ኤልምያስ ወአዛርያስ, and ሊቀ ካህናት ‘chief-of priests’ and ሊቀ ዲያቆናት ‘chief-of deacons’ are constructs naming their offices. I do not assign the two titles to the two men (?): taken in order Elmeyas would be the chief of priests, but unit 29 gives Azariah the priesthood, and ch. 45 calls both ‘sons of priests’. The next verbs ሐደሱ, ገብሩ are 3mp perfects, ‘they renewed, they made’, with መንግሥተ and ሕገ as objects; I take the subject to be ደቂቀ ኀይለ እስራኤል ‘sons-of strength-of Israel’, ‘the sons of the host of Israel’ (?), in the -ä form this unit uses for subjects (አልባበ, ሕዝበ ኢትዮጵያ), and ንጉሦሙ ‘their king’ then agrees with them. The other reading takes ሕገ as a construct, ‘the law of the sons of the host of Israel’, with the clergy as subject (?). ንጉሦሙ ዳዊት ‘their king David’: Menelik under his regnal name. ደብተራ ስምዕ ‘tent-of testimony’ is the tabernacle that houses the Ark. ተሐደሰት ‘was renewed’ (T-stem, 3fs, agreeing with መንግሥት); በርሀ ‘shone’ takes the plural አልባበ (አልባብ, plural of ልብ ‘heart’) as subject, ‘hearts shone’. በርእየ ጽዮን ‘at the seeing-of Zion’ (infinitive in construct); ታቦተ ሕጉ ‘ark-of his law’ is in apposition. ወገደፉ ‘and they cast away’ (ገደፈ); ሕዝበ ኢትዮጵያ ‘people-of Ethiopia’ is the subject in the -ä form. ለዘ ፡ ገብሮሙ is printed as two words (ለዘ ‘to him who’); ገብሮሙ ‘made them’ (ገብረ + -ሙ). This is one long unit of 39 words, kept whole as it is one sentence.

sentences.n: ንሣእ ‘take!’ (imperative of ነሥአ); ወሀብኩከ ‘I have given you’ (1cs perfect + -ከ). Then five 1cs perfects in -ኩ (አንገሥኩ, ኀረይኩ, ሠመርኩ, አዕበይኩ, አክበርኩ), each followed by ዘእግዚኣብሔር + the same verb in the 3ms (አንገሠ, ኀረየ, ሠምረ, አዕበየ, አክበረ): ዘ- ‘the one whom’, and the verb of her act is matched by God’s. The pattern is deliberate; the five verbs are the causatives አንገሠ, አዕበየ, አክበረ and the simple ኀረየ, ሠምረ. ቀዋሚሃ ለደብተራሁ ‘attendant at his tent’, as in ch. 25–26 (ቀዋሚ ‘one who stands, serves’; the -ሃ anticipates the feminine ደብተራ, and ለደብተራሁ names the owner), here a predicate accusative. ላእከ ታቦተ ኪዳኑ ወሕጉ ‘servant-of the ark-of his covenant and his law’. መጋቤ ‘steward-of / distributor’; ለአቤራቲሁ I cannot identify (?), perhaps ‘his needy ones’ from the parallel with orphans. ወሃቤ ሲሳይ ‘giver-of food’ (ወሃቢ ‘giver’ in construct; the ወ belongs to the word, as in ወወሃቤ, ch. 24, and not ‘and’). እጓለ ማውታ ‘child-of the dead’ = orphan. The ፨ ends the speech she gives.

sentences.i: The king rose, girded up his mantle (?), bowed to his mother, and said to her: You are queen, my lady, and I will be sent wherever you command me, whether to death or to life. Where you send me I shall be sent, and where you dispatch me I shall serve; and everything you command me, I will do;
sentences.n: ወተንሥአ ንጉሥ ‘and the king rose’ (verb first). ወቀነተ ዘይትዐጸፍ: ቀነተ ‘he girded’ (cf. መቀነት ‘girdle’, ch. 24) and ዘይትዐጸፍ ‘that which he wraps himself in’ (relative + T-stem imperfect of ዐጸፈ), so ‘he girded up his mantle’ (?), a gesture of readiness and respect; the sense is a guess. ሰገደ ለእሙ ‘he bowed to his mother’ (እም + -ሁ, written እሙ). ወይቤላ ‘and he said to her’. ንግሥትሰ አንቲ ‘as for queen, you (are)’ (-ሰ contrast). እግዝእትየ ‘my lady’. እትለአክ ‘I am sent’ (1cs imperfect of ተለአከ; ‘serve’ is also possible, so the second occurrence is given as ‘serve’), after በኀበ ኵሉ ዘአዘዝክኒ ‘to where all that you commanded me’ and ዘአዘዝክኒ ‘what you commanded me’ (2fs perfect + -ኒ). እመሂ … ወእመሂ ‘whether … or’. ኀበ ‘where’; ፈነውክኒ ‘you sent me’ (ፈነወ) with እትፌነው ‘I shall be sent’ (T-stem, passive); ለአክኒ ‘you sent me’ (ለአከ) with እትለአክ ‘I shall serve’. እገብር ‘I do’. The speaker is David–Menelik; the speech runs to unit 34.

sentences.i: For you are the head and I am the foot; you are the lady and I am your servant; everything is done at your word, there is no one who goes beyond your command, and I will do all that you wish.
sentences.n: ርእስ ‘head’, እግር ‘foot’: the body image of ruler and subject. አልቦ ዘ- ‘there is none who’. ይትገበር ‘it is done’ (T-stem, passive of ገብረ). ይትዐደው ‘goes beyond, transgresses’ (ተዐደወ). በቃልኪ ‘by your word’ and እምትእዛዝኪ ‘from your command’ take the 2fs suffix -ኪ. ዘፈቀድኪ ‘what you wished’ (ፈቀደ).

sentences.i: For they told us that he will be angry if we do not direct our heart to doing his will, and do not act well in all his commands concerning Zion, the dwelling of God’s glory;
sentences.n: ይቤሉነ ‘they said to us’ (3mp of ይቤ + -ነ) governs the report እስመ ይትመዐዕ ‘that he will be angry’ (T-stem, root m-ʿ-ʿ). ለእመ ‘if’; ኢያርታዕነ ‘we do not make straight’ (the causative አርትዐ ‘direct, set right’, with ልበነ ‘our heart’). ለገቢረ ‘to doing’ (infinitive in construct). ፈቃዲ: the printed form is read as ፈቃዱ ‘his will’ (?). ወኢያሠነይነ ‘and we do not do well’ (አሠነየ). ለእ ፡ ግዚኣብሔር is a source slip, a word split by a wordspace, printed as in the edition; read ለእግዚኣብሔር ‘of/for God’. ማኅደረ ስብሐቲሁ ለእግዚኣብሔር ‘dwelling-of his glory, God’s’ (anticipatory suffix, then ለ- naming the owner) = ‘the dwelling of God’s glory’, in apposition to ጽዮን.

sentences.i: But if we do not direct our heart to him, he will be angry with us, turn his face away from us, and scourge us; our enemies will plot against us (?), fear and trembling will come upon us from where we did not expect it, and they will rise against us, wage war on us, and destroy us.
sentences.n: ወእመሰ ‘but if’. ይትመዐዐነ ‘he will be angry with us’ (T-stem, root m-ʿ-ʿ, + -ነ). ወይመይጥ ገጾ ‘and he will turn his face’ (ይመይጥ, G imperfect of መይጠ ‘turn’, not the causative; ‘turn the face away’ is the Hebrew-style idiom of God’s withdrawal). ወይቀሥፈነ ‘and he will scourge us’ (ቀሠፈ). ይትሐበለዩነ I read as ‘they will plot against us’ (a T-stem of ሐበለ, ?). ጸላእትነ ‘our enemies’. ወይመጽአነ ‘and there will come on us’ (መጽአ with the object suffix). ፍርሀት ወረዓድ ‘fear and trembling’. እምኀበ ኢተሐዘብነ ‘from where we did not expect’ (ተሐዘበ ‘think, expect’). ይጸብዑነ አጽባአ ‘they will fight us fights’, a cognate accusative (ጸብአ ‘war’); ያጠፍኡነ ‘they will destroy us’. Fear of the enemy is the punishment for failing in the Ark’s service.

sentences.n: ወለእመሰ ‘but if’, the opposite case. ፈቃደ እግዚኣብሔር ‘will-of God’; ግብራ ለጽዮን ‘her service, Zion’s’ (ግብር + -ኣ, doubled by ለ-). ንከውን ኄራን ‘we shall be good’ (ኄራን, plural of ኄር ‘good, kind’). አልቦ ዘይክል ‘there is none who can’ and አሕሥሞ, a form I cannot parse securely (?), perhaps from አሕሠመ ‘harm’ (the root also behind አሕሠምኪ in ch. 64–65, where the sense is not settled either). ደብረ መቅደሱ ‘the mountain-of his sanctuary’ (Zion). እንዘ ሀለወት ማኅደሩ ‘while his dwelling is (3fs) present’.

sentences.i: And behold, we have brought with us, written down, the whole law of the kingdom and the command of God which Zadok the high priest declared to us when he anointed me with the anointing of kingship in the house of God’s sanctuary, while in his hand was the horn of ointment oil, for priesthood and for kingship;
sentences.n: ወነዋ ‘and behold’. ዘአምጻእነ ጽሑፍ ‘what we brought, written’. ሕገ መንግሥት ‘law-of kingdom’ and ትእዛዘ እግዚኣብሔር ‘command-of God’ are constructs; ዘነገረነ ‘which told us’ (ነገረ + -ነ). ሰዶቅ is Zadok, who anointed Solomon (1 Kings 1:39); here he anoints David–Menelik in Jerusalem (chs. 38–40). አመ ‘when’. ይቀብአኒ ‘he anointed me’ (ቀብአ + -ኒ); ቅብአ መንግሥት ‘anointing-of kingdom’. ለእግዚኣብሔር follows ቤተ መቅደሱ as a doubling of the possessor (the house pattern). እንዘ ውስተ እዴሁ ‘while in his hand’ (እድ + -ሁ). ቀርነ ቅብአ ዕፍረት ‘horn-of anointing oil’ (ዕፍረት ‘ointment, spice’), ዘክህነት ወዘመንግሥት ‘of priesthood and of kingdom’.

sentences.i: They did for us what is according to his law, and we were anointed (?), Azariah for the priesthood and I for the kingship, and Almeyas as the mouth of God, the keeper of the law, who is Zion’s guardian and the ears of the king in every path of righteousness.
sentences.n: ወገብሩ ለነ ዘበሕጉ ‘and they did for us what is by his law’ (ዘ- + በ- + ሕግ + -ሁ). ተቀ ፡ ባእነ is printed as two words, a source slip: joined it is ተቀባእነ, which I read as ተቀብአነ ‘we were anointed’ (T-stem of ቀብአ, 1cp, ?; the printed ā is not in that form). The reading suits unit 28, where the horn is ‘for priesthood and for kingdom’. አዛርያስ ለክህነት ‘Azariah for priesthood’, ወአነ ለመንግሥት ‘and I for kingdom’. አልምያስ is probably the same man as ኤልምያስ of unit 4 and ch. 45 (?); no verb is repeated for him, so ‘as’ is supplied in the English. አፈ እግዚኣብሔር ‘mouth-of God’ and ዐቃቤ ሕግ ‘keeper-of law’ are construct chains; ዘውእቱ ዐቃቢሃ ለጽዮን ‘who is her keeper, Zion’s’ (-ሃ doubled by ለ-). እዘኒሁ ለንጉሥ ‘his ears, the king’s’ (the stem እዘኒ- is unexplained, perhaps for አእዛኒሁ (?)), the king’s hearer. ፍኖተ ጽድቅ ‘way-of righteousness’ (cf. Psalm 23:3).

sentences.n: ወአዘዙኒ ‘and they commanded me’ (አዘዘ + -ኒ). ከመ አልቦ ዘእገብር ‘that there be nothing which I do’. ዘእንበለ በምክሮሙ ‘except by their counsel’ (ምክር + -ሙ). ወአቀሙነ ‘and they set us’ (አቀመ + -ነ). ቅድመ ‘before’ (construct); ሊቃውንተ እስራኤል ‘chiefs-of Israel’ (construct plural). ሕዝብ ይሰምዕ ‘the people hear’; እንዘ ይኤዝዘነ ‘while he was commanding us’ (imperfect after እንዘ). sentences.i: And the jubilee-horn (?) and the organ (?) were blown, and the voice of their harps and their ብዕዛ (?) and the sound of their cries (?), which was done then at the gates of Jerusalem.
sentences.n: ተነፍኀ ‘it was blown’ (T-stem passive of ነፍሐ), singular though the subjects are several. ኢዮብልዮስ is a loan, Greek-Latin ‘jubilee’ (from Hebrew yôbēl, the ram’s horn); ኣርጋኖን is Greek ὄργανον ‘instrument, organ’ (so ‘pipe’, ?). ቃለ ‘voice-of’, ድምፀ ‘sound-of’ (constructs). ዕንዚራቲሆሙ ‘their harps’ (as in the published parts, though the type is uncertain, ?). ብዕዛቲሆሙ (a word left uncertain in chs. 38–39 and 55–56, ?) and ጽራኃቲሆሙ ‘their cries’ (?; ጽራኅ ‘cry’, as in ch. 49–50, plural + -ሆሙ; an instrument is the other possibility). ዘተገብረ ‘which was done’. አሜሃ ‘then’. በአናቅጺሃ ለኢየሩሳሌም ‘at its gates, Jerusalem’s’ (አናቅጽ plural of አንቀጽ ‘gate’). This is a reminder of the anointing in ch. 38–40.

sentences.i: For it seemed to us that the earth shook to its foundations and that the heaven thundered above us;
sentences.n: መሰለነ ‘it seemed to us’ (መሰለ ‘resemble, seem’ + -ነ). ዘታድለቀልቅ ‘that it shook’ (ዘ- introduces the thing seen; ታድለቀልቅ is a quadriliteral 3fs, ምድር being feminine) and ዘያንጐደጒድ ‘that it thundered’ (quadriliteral, 3ms). እስከ መሠረታቲሃ ‘until its foundations’ (መሠረት, plural መሠረታት + -ሃ). ሰማይኒ ‘heaven also’ (-ኒ). በመልዕልቴነ ‘above us’ (a preposition with the suffix). The text does not say what caused the shaking and thunder; it follows the blast of the trumpets at Jerusalem (unit 31).

sentences.i: And the heart, too, trembled along with its knees (?).
sentences.n: ወልብኒ ‘and the heart also’ (-ኒ). ትርዕድ ‘it trembles’ (3fs imperfect of ርዕደ, so ልብ is treated as feminine here, ?). ምስለ ብረኪሃ ‘with her knees’ (ብረክ ‘knee’, as in ch. 55–56 ለብረክየ ‘to my knees’, + -ሃ ‘her’; the plural form is not as expected, and the ‘her’ has no clear antecedent, ?). The run of ፨ marks the end of the chapter and the part.

glossary.ኀደጉ: ኀደገ — they left (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.ኄራን: ኄር — good (adjective, plural ኄራን; ንከውን ኄራን 'we shall be good')
glossary.ንከውን: ኮነ — we shall be (1cp imperf., k-w-n)
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.ንግሥተ: ንግሥት — queen (noun, fem.; construct 'queen of' before the following noun)
glossary.ንግሥትሰ: ንግሥት — queen, indeed (noun, fem. + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.አልባበ: ልብ — hearts of (plural አልባብ, construct state; አልባበ ሰብእ 'hearts of men')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አሕሥሞ: አሕሠመ — to harm, do harm (infinitive-like form (?) of the causative አሕሠመ after ዘይክል 'who can'; cf. አሕሠምኪ ch. 64–65, whose sense is also unclear; meaning from context) (?)
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
glossary.አሠነይነ: አሠነየ — we did well (1cp perfect, causative of ሠነየ 'be good', after ለእመ 'if')
glossary.አንገሠ: አንገሠ — he made king, enthroned (3ms perfect, causative of ነግሠ)
glossary.አእሩገ: አረጋዊ — elder, old man (plural አእሩግ (?); construct 'elders-of')
glossary.አክበረ: አክበረ — he honoured (3ms perfect, causative of ከብረ)
glossary.አዋልደ: ወለት — daughters of (noun, plural አዋልድ, construct)
glossary.አዕበየ: አዕበየ — he magnified (3ms perfect, causative of ዐብየ 'be great')
glossary.አዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
glossary.አድባረ: ደብር — mountains of (plural አድባር of ደብር 'mountain', construct) · accusative 'mountains' in a list (አድባረ ወአውግረ አእባነ ወመሬተ 'mountains and hills (?), stones and earth'); construct reading also possible (?)
glossary.አጽባአ: ጽብእ — battles, war (noun, plural አጽባእ, accusative; ይጸብዑነ አጽባአ 'wage war on us')
glossary.አፈ: አፍ — mouth of (noun, construct state; አፈ እግዚኣብሔር 'mouth of God')
glossary.ኢሠምረ: ሠምረ — he was not pleased (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, ś-m-r)
glossary.ኢተሐዘብነ: ተሐዘበ — we did not expect (ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, tä-stem, 'consider, expect'; እምኀበ ኢተሐዘብነ 'from where we did not expect')
glossary.ኢተኀድር: ኀደረ — she does not dwell (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs imperfect, G, ḫ-d-r)
glossary.ኢታንግሡ: አንገሠ — you (pl.) shall not enthrone (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp subjunctive, causative of ነግሠ 'reign', after ከመ 'that')
glossary.ኢያርታዕነ: አርትዐ — we did not set straight (ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, causative of ርትዐ 'be straight, right')
glossary.ኢዮብልዮስ: ኢዮቤልዮስ — jubilee, jubilee-horn (?) (loanword from Greek, here spelled ኢዮብልዮስ; subject of ተነፍኀ 'was blown') (?)
glossary.ኤልምያስ: ኤልምያስ — Elmeyas (proper name; named with Azariah as one of those who adjured them; his office is not given in this unit, and ወአልምያስ below is probably the same man) (?)
glossary.እመሂ: እመ — whether, if (conjunction + enclitic -ሂ; እመሂ ... ወእመሂ 'whether ... or whether')
glossary.እመዐቱ: መዐት — from his wrath (እም- 'from' + noun 'wrath' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.እምትእዛዝኪ: ትእዛዝ — from your command (እም- 'from' + noun + -ኪ '2fs your')
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እትለአክ: ተለአከ — I shall serve (?) (tä-stem 1cs imperf.; from ለአከ 'send', so 'be sent' is also possible) (?)
glossary.እትፌነው: ተፈነወ — I shall be sent (1cs imperfect, tä-stem passive of ፈነወ)
glossary.እነግረክሙ: ነገረ — I will tell you (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G, n-g-r, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
glossary.እገብር: ገብረ — I do, make (1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ኦእግዝእትየ: እግዝእት — O my lady (ኦ vocative particle + noun, fem. + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኬንያሃ: ኬንያ — her craftsman, maker (noun, 'craftsman, maker' (?) as in ch. 13–16, + -ሃ '3fs her'; parallel to ወገባሪሃ) (?)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
glossary.ወሀብኩከ: ወሀበ — I have given you (1cs perfect, w-h-b, + -ከ '2ms you'; ንሣእ ወሀብኩከ 'take; I have given it to you'; the ወ is part of the verb, not 'and')
glossary.ወሃቤ: ወሃቢ — giver of (agent noun of ወሀበ 'give', construct ወሃቤ; the initial ወ is a root letter, not 'and', as in ወወሃቤ ch. 24; ወሃቤ ሲሳይ 'giver of food')
glossary.ወለሠዊዕ: ሠዊዕ — and to sacrificing (ወ- + ለ- + verbal noun, from ሠውዐ 'sacrifice')
glossary.ወለእመሰ: እመ — and if indeed, but if (ወ- + ለእመ + enclitic -ሰ contrastive)
glossary.ወሊቀ: ሊቅ — and chief of (ወ- + noun, construct state; ወሊቀ ዲያቆናት 'and chief of deacons')
glossary.ወልብኒ: ልብ — and the heart also (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
glossary.ወሐናጺሃ: ሐናጺ — and her builder (ወ- + agent noun of ሐነጸ 'build' + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወሐደሱ: ሐደሰ — and they renewed (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-d-s)
glossary.ወሕጉ: ሕግ — and his law (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted -ጉ)
glossary.ወመሐሉ: መሐለ — and swear! (ወ- + 2mp imperative, ወመሐሉ ሊተ) · and they swore (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ወመሐሉ ሎቱ) (G, m-ḥ-l)
glossary.ወመማክርት: መምከር — and counsellors (ወ- + plural መማክርት; the singular is not confirmed; from ምክር 'counsel')
glossary.ወመነኖሙ: መነነ — and he despised them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-n-n, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወመንፈሱ: መንፈስ — and his spirit (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወመኳንንት: መኰንን — and nobles, governors (ወ- + plural መኳንንት)
glossary.ወመገብት: መጋቢ — and stewards (?) (ወ- + noun, plural; house reading 'stewards' ch. 29, 38–39, 43; the plural form is not as expected) (?)
glossary.ወመጽአት: መጽአ — and she came (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ; subject ጽዮን)
glossary.ወሠመርኩ: ሠምረ — and I approved (ወ- + 1cs perfect, G, ś-m-r; transitive 'approve, be pleased with')
glossary.ወረዓድ: ረዓድ — and trembling (ወ- + noun; cf. ርዕደ 'tremble')
glossary.ወርትዐ: ርትዕ — and uprightness (ወ- + noun, accusative; cf. ርትዐ 'be straight, right')
glossary.ወሰማይኒ: ሰማይ — and heaven also (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወሰብሖ: ሰብሖ — and praise (ወ- + verbal noun of ሰብሐ 'praise', accusative)
glossary.ወሰገለ: ሰገል — and sorcery, divination (ወ- + noun, accusative; meaning inferred from the list of abandoned vices) (?)
glossary.ወሰገደ: ሰገደ — and he bowed down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ወቀነተ: ቀነተ — and he girded (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, q-n-t)
glossary.ወቃለ: ቃል — and the word of (ወ- + noun, construct 'word of')
glossary.ወበርሀ: በርሀ — and it shone (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-r-h)
glossary.ወብዕዛቲሆሙ: ብዕዛ — and their ? (ወ- + unknown noun, plural ብዕዛት (?) + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; an instrument or sound among the trumpets, not identified) (?)
glossary.ወተሐደሰት: ተሐደሰ — and it was renewed (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem passive of ሐደሰ; subject መንግሥት 'kingdom')
glossary.ወተመነኑ: ተመነነ — and they were despised (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem passive of መነነ 'despise'; subject ሕዝበ እስራኤል)
glossary.ወተቀ: ተቀብአ — and we were anointed (?) (first part of ወተቀ ፡ ባእነ; the joined word ወተቀባእነ is read as ወ- + ተቀብአነ, 1cp perfect, tä-stem passive of ቀብአ, though the ā is not in that form; one word split by the wordspace) (?)
glossary.ወተነፍኀ: ተነፍኀ — and it was blown (ወ- + tä-stem 3ms perf. passive, n-f-ḫ)
glossary.ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተከዛ: ተከዘ — and they grieved (ወ- + tä-stem perfect ተከዛ, the ending -ኣ taken as 3fp to agree with the feminine plural አድባር 'mountains', as ኀስራ above; ተፈሥሐ beside it is 3ms) (?)
glossary.ወተፈሥሐት: ተፈሥሐ — and she rejoiced (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወትቤሎሙ: ይቤ — and she said to them (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of the irregular verb 'say' + ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወኀረይኩ: ኀረየ — and I chose (ወ- + 1cs perfect, G, ḫ-r-y)
glossary.ወኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at (preposition; ወ- 'and') · and where, and wherever (conjunction, ወኀበ ሖረ ይተልዎ 'and wherever he went it pursued him')
glossary.ወኀበሰ: ኀበ — but where, and where indeed (ወ- 'and' + conjunction ኀበ + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወነዋ: ነዋ — and behold, here is (ወ- + interjection ነዋ)
glossary.ወአልምያስ: አልምያስ — and Almeyas (ወ- + proper name; variant of ኤልምያስ?) (?)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአምለኩ: አምለከ — and they worshipped (ወ- + 3mp perfect, denominative of አምላክ 'god', as in chs. 13–16, 28)
glossary.ወአምሐልዎሙ: አምሐለ — and they made them swear, adjured them (ወ- + 3mp perfect አምሐሉ, causative of መሐለ 'swear', + -ሙ '3mp them'; subject ኤልምያስ and አዛርያስ)
glossary.ወአሠነይነ: አሠነየ — and we did well (ወ- + 1cp perfect, causative of ሠነየ)
glossary.ወአቀሙነ: አቀመ — and they set us, made us stand (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ቆመ 'stand', + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወአብጽሐነ: አብጽሐ — and he brought us (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of በጽሐ 'arrive', + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወአንብዐ: አንብዕ — and tears (ወ- + noun, plural; accusative)
glossary.ወአንቲ: አንቲ — and you (ወ- + 2fs independent pronoun; spoken to his mother)
glossary.ወአንገሥኩ: አንገሠ — and I made king (ወ- + 1cs perfect, causative of ነግሠ)
glossary.ወአክበርኩ: አክበረ — and I honoured (ወ- + 1cs perfect, causative of ከብረ 'be honoured')
glossary.ወአዕበይኩ: አዕበየ — and I magnified (ወ- + 1cs perfect, causative of ዐብየ 'be great')
glossary.ወአዘዙኒ: አዘዘ — and they commanded me (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ʾ-z-z, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወአዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — and Azariah (ወ- + proper name; the Azariah of the earlier parts; named here with Elmeyas, and the two offices ሊቀ ካህናት and ሊቀ ዲያቆናት are not assigned to the two men)
glossary.ወአጣዕዎ: አጣዕዎ — and idolatry (?) (ወ- + noun, perhaps related to ጣዖት 'idol'; reading uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወአፍቀሩ: አፍቀረ — and they loved (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative)
glossary.ወኢታንግሡ: አንገሠ — and you shall not enthrone (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp subjunctive, causative, continuing ከመ ኢታንግሡ)
glossary.ወኢያሠነይነ: አሠነየ — and we did not do well (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, causative of ሠነየ 'be good')
glossary.ወኢይትአተት: ተአተተ — and he is not withdrawn (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive, 'be removed') (?)
glossary.ወኢይትፈለጥ: ተፈለጠ — and he is not parted, separated (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, Gt passive-reflexive of ፈለጠ)
glossary.ወኣርጋኖን: ኣርጋኖን — and organ (?) (ወ- + loanword from Greek ὄργανον 'instrument'; a musical instrument, 'organ' by convention) (?)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወእመሂ: እመ — and whether, or whether (ወ- 'and' + conjunction እመ + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወእመሰ: እመ — and if (ወ- 'and' + conditional conjunction + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወእምእደ: እድ — and from the hand of (ወ- + እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወእዘኒሁ: እዝን — and his ears (ወ- + noun 'ear' + -ሁ '3ms his'; the stem እዘኒ- is unexplained, perhaps for አእዛኒሁ, plural አእዛን + -ሁ; ወእዘኒሁ ለንጉሥ 'and the ears of the king') (?)
glossary.ወከብሩ: ከብረ — and they were honoured (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G; subject አእሩገ ኢትዮጵያ 'elders of Ethiopia')
glossary.ወከብራ: ከብረ — and they were honoured (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G, k-b-r; subject አዋልደ 'daughters')
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወወሀበት: ወሀበ — and she gave (ወ- + 3fs perfect, w-h-b)
glossary.ወዘመንግሥት: መንግሥት — and of kingship (ወ- + ዘ- 'of' + noun)
glossary.ወየዐቅበነ: ዐቀበ — and he will keep us (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ʿ-q-b, + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወያጠፍኡነ: አጥፍአ — and they will destroy us (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative, + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወይመይጥ: ሜጠ — and he will turn (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-y-ṭ; 'turn away')
glossary.ወይመጽአነ: መጽአ — and will come upon us (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ, + -ነ '1cp upon us'; subject ፍርሀት 'fear')
glossary.ወይቀሥፈነ: ቀሠፈ — and he will scourge us (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, q-ś-f, + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her') · masculine form where a woman speaks to her sister and ትቤላ is expected (ወይቤላ ዝንቱ ንዋየ አቡነ 'and she said to her: this property of our father') (?)
glossary.ወይትሐበለዩነ: ተሐበለየ — and they will plot against us (?) (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem of a III-y verb (the -ዩ), + -ነ '1cp us'; root ḥ-b-l, cf. ሐበለ in ch. 60a; subject ጸላእትነ 'our enemies'; the stem is not confirmed) (?)
glossary.ወይትነሥኡ: ተንሥአ — and they will rise (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, Gt)
glossary.ወይጸብዑነ: ጸብአ — and they will fight us (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ṣ-b-ʾ, spelled with ዑ, + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወድምፀ: ድምፅ — and the sound of (ወ- + noun, construct 'sound of')
glossary.ወገበርነ: ገብረ — and we did (ወ- + 1cp perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወገብሩ: ገብረ — and they made, amounted to (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-r) · also 'and they did' (ወገብሩ ለነ ዘበሕጉ 'and they did for us what is by his law')
glossary.ወገብኡ: ገብአ — and they returned (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወገደፉ: ገደፈ — and they cast away (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, g-d-f)
glossary.ወግልፈዋት: ግልፈት — and carved images (ወ- + plural ግልፈዋት; the singular and exact sense are uncertain, as in chs. 13–16, 27, 33–34) (?)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ዐቃቢሃ: ዐቃቢ — her keeper, guardian (agent noun + -ሃ '3fs her'; ዐቃቢሃ ለጽዮን 'Zion's guardian')
glossary.ዐቃቤ: ዐቃቢ — keeper, guardian (agent noun of ዐቀበ 'keep', construct 'keeper of'; ዐቃቤ ሕግ 'keeper of the law')
glossary.ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form) · as a noun, 'great ones, notables' (construct, ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'notables of Israel')
glossary.ዕንዚራቲሆሙ: ዕንዚራ — their harps (noun, plural ዕንዚራት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ዘመገበነ: መገበ — who fed us (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, m-g-b, 'feed', + -ነ '1cp us') (?)
glossary.ዘርእዮተ: ርእዮት — of the vision of (ዘ- 'of' + noun ርእዮት 'sight, vision', construct; verbal noun of ርእየ 'see'; the sense of the phrase ዘርእዮተ ጽዮን is uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘበሕጉ: ሕግ — what is by his law (ዘ- 'that which' + በ- 'by' + ሕግ 'law' + -ሁ 'his', contracted -ጉ)
glossary.ዘተንሥአት: ተንሥአ — that she rose (ዘ- relative 'that' + 3fs perfect, Gt; in በእንተ ዘተንሥአት ጽዮን 'because Zion rose up', በእንተ ዘ- is 'because')
glossary.ዘተገብረ: ተገብረ — which was done (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ዘታድለቀልቅ: አድለቅለቀ — that it shook (ዘ- 'that' + 3fs imperfect, causative quadriliteral; subject ምድር 'earth', fem.)
glossary.ዘትካት: ትካት — of establishment, the established (?) (ዘ- + noun; cf. ተከለ 'plant, establish') (?) · ከመ ዘትካት 'as before, as formerly' (idiom, of the face and gaze) (?)
glossary.ዘነገረነ: ነገረ — who told us (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ዘአምጻእነ: አምጽአ — which we brought (ዘ- 'that which' + 1cp perfect, causative of መጽአ 'come')
glossary.ዘአዘዝክኒ: አዘዘ — what you commanded me (ዘ- 'that which' + 2fs perfect አዘዝኪ, with -ክ for -ኪ before the suffix, + -ኒ '1cs me'; said to the queen)
glossary.ዘአጋንንት: ጋኔን — of demons (ዘ- 'of' + plural አጋንንት; ተውኔተ አማልክት ዘአጋንንት 'revels of the gods of demons')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘእገብር: ገብረ — that I do (ዘ- 'what' + 1cs imperfect, G; አልቦ ዘእገብር 'there is nothing I do')
glossary.ዘእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — whom God (made king, etc.) (ዘ- 'the one whom' + noun as subject of the following verb; ዘእግዚኣብሔር አንገሠ 'whom God made king')
glossary.ዘክህነት: ክህነት — of priesthood (ዘ- 'of' + noun; ቅብአ ዕፍረት ዘክህነት 'oil of ointment for priesthood')
glossary.ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
glossary.ዘያንጐደጒድ: አንጐድጐደ — that it thundered (ዘ- 'that' + 3ms imperfect, causative quadriliteral)
glossary.ዘያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — who loves (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
glossary.ዘይትዐደው: ተዐደወ — who transgresses (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ)
glossary.ዘይትዐጸፍ: ተዐጸፈ — what he wraps himself in, his mantle (ዘ- 'what, that which' + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem, of ዐጸፈ 'cover, wrap'; the sense is a guess) (?)
glossary.ዘይክል: ከሀለ — who is able (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, k-h-l)
glossary.ዘፈቀድኪ: ፈቀደ — what you wished (ዘ- 'that which' + 2fs perfect, G, f-q-d)
glossary.ያድኅነኒ: አድኀነ — that he save me (3ms subjunctive, causative of ድኅነ 'be safe', + -ኒ '1cs me'; after ከመ)
glossary.ይሰምዕ: ሰምዐ — he hears, listens (3ms imperfect, G, s-m-ʿ; ኵሉ ሕዝብ ይሰምዕ 'all the people listened')
glossary.ይቀብአኒ: ቀብአ — he anointed me (3ms imperfect, G, q-b-ʾ, + -ኒ '1cs me'; አመ ይቀብአኒ 'when he anointed me', imperfect after አመ)
glossary.ይቤሉነ: ይቤ — they said to us (3mp perfect ይቤሉ of the defective verb 'say' + -ነ '1cp to us')
glossary.ይትመዐዐነ: ተምዕዐ — he will be angry with us (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, m-ʿ-ʿ, + -ነ '1cp with us')
glossary.ይትመዐዕ: ተምዕዐ — he is angry (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, m-ʿ-ʿ)
glossary.ይትገበር: ተገብረ — it is done (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r) · he sits, is seated (3ms imperfect, G, of sitting at table) · he will sit, take the seat (ዝንቱ ይነብር ህየንቴሁ 'this one will sit in his place')
glossary.ይኤዝዘነ: አዘዘ — he commands us (3ms imperfect + -ነ '1cp us'; spelled ይኤዝዘነ for the usual ያዝዘነ) (?)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ዲያቆናት: ዲያቆን — deacon (noun, plural ዲያቆናት; ሊቀ ዲያቆናት 'chief of deacons')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገበርነ: ገብረ — we do (1cp perfect, G, after ለእመ 'if')
glossary.ገብሮሙ: ገብረ — he made them (3ms perfect, G, g-b-r, + -ሙ '3mp them'; ለዘ ገብሮሙ 'to the one who made them')
glossary.ግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — God, second part (-ግዚኣብሔር; completes ለእ ፡ ግዚኣብሔር 'of God')
glossary.ጣዖቶሙ: ጣዖት — their idols (noun, collective singular + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ጸልዪ: ጸለየ — pray, intercede (2fs imperative, G, ṣ-l-y)
glossary.ጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — written; a writing (passive participle, noun)
glossary.ጽራኃቲሆሙ: ጽራኅ — their cries (?) (noun, plural ጽራኃት + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; from ጸርሐ 'cry out') (?)
glossary.ጽርሐ: ጽርሕ — hall, chamber, inner sanctuary (construct; Budge 'fortress')
glossary.ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
glossary.ፈቃዲ: ፈቃድ — his will (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling as in ወልዲ; ለገቢረ ፈቃዲ 'to doing his will')
glossary.ፈነውክኒ: ፈነወ — you sent me (2fs perfect, G, f-n-w, with -ክ for -ኪ before the suffix, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.፹፯: ፹፯ — 87, spoken ሰማንያ ወሰብዐቱ (sämanya wä-säbʿätu) 'eighty-seven'; chapter number (numeral, Ethiopic digits ፹ 80 + ፯ 7)
